global_piqa_completions.name: Global PIQA (Chang et al.)
global_piqa_completions.format: 2-way physical-commonsense completion, hand-written per language by native speakers

global_mmlu_full.name: Global-MMLU (Singh et al.)
global_mmlu_full.format: MC knowledge QA (MMLU), professional + community translations

include_base_44.name: INCLUDE (Romanou et al.)
include_base_44.format: MC regional exam questions, natively sourced

multiblimp.name: MultiBLiMP 1.0 (Jumelet et al.)
multiblimp.format: grammatical minimal pairs (subject-verb agreement), auto-generated from UD/UniMorph

hellaswag.venue: EMNLP 2023 (demo); English original Zellers et al. ACL 2019
hellaswag.name: Okapi m_hellaswag (Lai et al.)

arc.venue: EMNLP 2023 (demo); English original Clark et al. 2018
arc.name: Okapi m_arc (Lai et al.)

lambada_openai_mt.venue: no paper (EleutherAI machine translation of LAMBADA, Paperno et al. ACL 2016)
lambada_openai_mt.name: LAMBADA multilingual

afrimmlu.name: IrokoBench AfriMMLU (Adelani et al.)
afrimmlu.format: MC knowledge QA, human-translated (MMLU subset, 5 subjects)

rf_belebele.name: Belebele (Bandarkar et al.)
rf_belebele.format: cloze reformulation of belebele: passage + question, the four answers scored as continuations

rf_global_mmlu_full.name: Global-MMLU (Singh et al.)
rf_global_mmlu_full.format: cloze reformulation of global_mmlu_full: question only, the four options scored as continuations

rf_include_base_44.name: INCLUDE (Romanou et al.)
rf_include_base_44.format: cloze reformulation of include_base_44: question only, the four options scored as continuations

rfgm_include_base_44.name: INCLUDE (Romanou et al.)
rfgm_include_base_44.format: Gemini statement rewrite of include_base_44: stem + four short continuations, scored as continuations (rf-data/rfgm/<task>.jsonl)

rf_commonsense_qa.name: commonsense_qa
rf_commonsense_qa.format: cloze reformulation of commonsense_qa: question only, the five options scored as continuations

rf_cultural_bench_easy.name: cultural_bench_easy
rf_cultural_bench_easy.format: cloze reformulation of cultural_bench_easy: question only, the four options scored as continuations

bbh_mcq.name: BIG-Bench Hard (Suzgun et al. 2023)
bbh_mcq.format: BBH's closed-form subtasks as logprob: the published item incl. its (A)-(R) option block, the letters scored as continuations (no chain of thought)

rf_bbh_mcq.name: BIG-Bench Hard (Suzgun et al. 2023)
rf_bbh_mcq.format: cloze reformulation of bbh_mcq: the stem without the option block, the option strings scored as continuations

bbh_cloze.name: BIG-Bench Hard (Suzgun et al. 2023)
bbh_cloze.format: BBH's two-way subtasks as logprob: the published item, the two answer strings scored as continuations (already cloze; no reformulated twin)

acp_bench_mcq.name: ACP-Bench (Kokel et al. 2025)
acp_bench_mcq.format: ACP-Bench's multiple-choice subtasks as logprob: context + the question incl. its A.-D. list, the letters scored as continuations

rf_acp_bench_mcq.name: ACP-Bench (Kokel et al. 2025)
rf_acp_bench_mcq.format: cloze reformulation of acp_bench_mcq: context + the bare query, the four action strings scored as continuations

acp_bench_cloze.name: ACP-Bench (Kokel et al. 2025)
acp_bench_cloze.format: ACP-Bench's boolean subtasks as logprob: context + question, yes/no scored as continuations (already cloze; no reformulated twin)

include_v2_og.name: INCLUDE v2 (Romanou et al.)
include_v2_og.format: cloze INCLUDE v2: question only in the item's own language, the four options scored as continuations

include_v2_en.name: INCLUDE v2 (Romanou et al.)
include_v2_en.format: cloze INCLUDE v2: the English translation of the same items, the four options scored as continuations

rf_mmlu.name: mmlu
rf_mmlu.format: cloze reformulation of mmlu: question only, the four options scored as continuations

rfgm_belebele.name: Belebele (Bandarkar et al.)
rfgm_belebele.format: Gemini statement rewrite of belebele: stem + four short continuations, scored as continuations (rf-data/rfgm/<task>.jsonl)
